title: 第1310章 第一重天人界胜第1309章 三年血战四界溃败
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
战场之上，局势已经渐渐明朗。
四界联军折损大半，剩余的不到百万亿大军士气已经跌落到了谷底。
尤其是当它们发现，无论它们怎么杀，那些人界弟子都不曾后退半步的时候，那种发自灵魂深处的恐惧便开始蔓延！
“不能再这样下去了！”
白傲天一刀斩退身前的人界剑修，那张虎目上第一次露出了焦急的神色。
圣羽那双金色的瞳孔中也闪过一丝凝重。
“必须杀了那个人！”
“只要他一死，人界弟子的士气必定崩溃！”
它的目光，死死盯着战场上那道如同杀神般的身影。
何平安！
那个从开战到现在，一人一剑斩杀了超过十万敌军的怪物！
一人可挡十万军！
这不是传说，这是现实！
而且何平安杀的，几乎全是四界最顶尖的天仙境妖孽！
“联手！只有联手杀了他，此战才有转机！”
戮天的魔瞳中翻涌着复杂到极点的光芒。
作为魔界天魔境的第一魔，它有属于自己的骄傲！
联手围攻一个同境的敌人，这对它来说是一种耻辱。
可是，它也清楚，若不如此，此战必败！
“好。”

“联手，杀他。”
下一刻，四道恐怖到极点的气息同时锁定了何平安。
这四位，每一个都是各自永恒大界中这个纪元最顶尖的妖孽！
甚至在以往几届都属于无敌的存在！
任何一位放在往届的帝路争锋中，都足以横扫一方！
尤其是戮天，同境之中，它从未遇到过敌手！
从未！
此刻，这四位站在极巅的无敌妖孽，同时将目光投向了何平安。
那一瞬间，整座第一重天战场的空气都仿佛凝固了。
何平安停下了脚步。
他感觉到了那四道锁定自己的气机，感觉到了那四股足以让任何天仙境生灵窒息的恐怖威压！
可他的脸上，依旧没有任何表情。
他只是缓缓抬起头，那双清澈的眼眸平静地注视着前方的四位统领。
持剑的那只手，很稳。
“人界，何平安。”
“请四位上路！”
轰！
话音落下的瞬间，何平安动了。
他的身形如同一柄出鞘的绝世神剑，朝着四大统领暴射而去。
戮天、白傲傲天、圣羽、骨灵同时出手。

血色的镰刀划破虚空，带着斩灭一切生机的恐怖魔威。
content_en:
On the battlefield, the situation has gradually become clearer.
Most of the Allied Forces of the Four Realms have been lost, and the morale of the remaining army of less than one hundred billion has fallen to the bottom.
Especially when they discovered that no matter how hard they killed, the human world disciples never took a step back, the fear from the depths of their souls began to spread!
"This can't go on like this!"
Bai Aotian slashed the human world sword cultivator in front of him with one strike, and for the first time, his tiger eyes showed an anxious look.
A trace of solemnity also flashed in Sheng Yu's golden pupils.
"That man must be killed!"
"As soon as he dies, the morale of the disciples in the human world will collapse!"
Its eyes were fixed on the figure that looked like a murderous god on the battlefield.
How safe!
That monster who has killed more than 100,000 enemy soldiers with one sword from the beginning of the war!
One person can stop an army of 100,000 people!
This is not a legend, this is reality!
Moreover, He Ping'an killed almost all of the top-notch Celestial Realm monsters in the four realms!
"Join forces! Only by joining forces to kill him can this battle turn around!"
An extremely complex light surged in Hu Tian's demon pupils.
As the number one demon in the Demon Realm and Heavenly Demon Realm, it has its own pride!
It would be a shame for it to join forces to besiege an enemy of the same territory.
However, it also knows that if this is not the case, this battle will be lost!
"Okay."
"Join hands and kill him."
The next moment, four extremely terrifying auras locked onto He Pingan at the same time.
Each of these four are the top monsters of this era in their respective eternal realms!
Even in the past few sessions, it was an invincible existence!
Any one of them in previous imperial battles would be enough to sweep one side away!
Especially killing the sky, it has never encountered an opponent in the same realm!
Never!
At this moment, these four invincible monsters standing at the top simultaneously turned their attention to He Pingan.
At that moment, the air in the entire first-level battlefield seemed to freeze.
He Pingan stopped.
He felt the four qi machines locked on him, and felt the four terrifying pressures that were enough to suffocate any creature in the Celestial Realm!
But there was still no expression on his face.
He just slowly raised his head, his clear eyes calmly staring at the four commanders in front of him.
The hand holding the sword is very steady.
"How safe is the human world?"
"Four of you please go on your way!"
Boom!
The moment the words fell, He Ping'an moved.
His figure was like an unsheathed peerless sword, shooting towards the four commanders.
Hu Tian, ​​Bai Ao Aotian, Sheng Yu, and Bone Spirit took action at the same time.
The bloody sickle pierced the void, carrying a terrifying power that destroyed all life.
